subject: info-ds
title: INFO.DS.-----C.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 289 (CMOA(II)-47). INFO-DS (information dissemination) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT (social reality). From C-CONT: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From SOC-RT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From PROJ-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information). From T-C-IMP: GRAD (gradualism). From MT-INFO: TRS (transition). From TRS: INFO-INTR (information interpretation) and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). From CRTF-D: ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics).
